site.description: Beverly de Jesus — 'Granny Bev' — offers warm, reliable nanny, newborn, and pet care across New York City, with over 30 years of experience and CPR certification.

hero.eyebrow: Nanny & pet care · New York City
hero.headline: Warm, reliable care for your [[little ones]] & ((furry friends)).
hero.lede: I'm Beverly — “Granny Bev” to the families I look after. For more than 30 years I've cared for newborns, toddlers, and pets across the city, with a gentle, hands-on touch and a love for life's small moments.

about.quote: She has a gift for making the smallest moments feel significant.
about.quoteCite: — a family Bev has cared for
about.heading: Caregiving is my calling, not just my job.
about.lead: For over three decades, families across New York City have trusted me with what matters most to them — their children and their pets.
paragraphs: I bring a calm, nurturing presence to every home, whether I'm settling a newborn into gentle routines, helping a toddler discover the world, or making sure a beloved pet is walked, fed, and happy. I'm meticulous about a tidy home and a well-stocked kitchen, and I believe the little things — a Friday treat, a slow walk to smell the flowers, a thoughtful surprise — are what children remember most.
Families know me as “Granny Bev,” and I take that warmth seriously. I show up dependable, organized, and ready to love your family like my own.
